Quest name: Biological survey of the Wrangel Island (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: St. Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r6 Ecological Research, r8 Biology, ARC(Far North Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery: Wrangel Island discovery (from "Biological survey of the Extreme North" quest)
Pre-requisite action (hidden): 1st Eastern Region of Eurasia (Far East of Eurasia) permit obtained
